patient_details.sql_template: SELECT * FROM patients WHERE name ILIKE :patient_name LIMIT 1
patient_details.description: Fetch basic demographic details for a patient.

patient_by_mrn.sql_template: SELECT * FROM patients WHERE mrn ILIKE :mrn LIMIT 1

patient_latest_report.sql_template: SELECT * FROM medical_reports r JOIN patients p ON r.patient_id = p.id WHERE p.name ILIKE :patient_name ORDER BY r.date DESC LIMIT 1
patient_latest_report.description: Fetch the latest medical report for a specific patient.

patient_history.sql_template: SELECT * FROM consultations c JOIN patients p ON c.patient_id = p.id WHERE p.name ILIKE :patient_name ORDER BY c.date DESC LIMIT 10
patient_history.description: Fetch consultation history for a patient.

attendance_today.sql_template: SELECT * FROM attendance WHERE staff_name ILIKE :staff_name AND date = CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 1
attendance_today.description: Check if a specific staff member is present today.

equipment_location.sql_template: SELECT * FROM equipment_items WHERE equipment_id ILIKE :equipment_id LIMIT 1
equipment_location.description: Find the last known location of a piece of equipment.

camera_status.sql_template: SELECT * FROM cameras WHERE name ILIKE :camera_name LIMIT 1
camera_status.description: Check the status and location of a camera.

unresolved_security_alerts.sql_template: SELECT * FROM security_alerts WHERE resolved = FALSE ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 10

all_active_security_rules.sql_template: SELECT * FROM security_rules WHERE is_active = TRUE

recent_camera_events.sql_template: SELECT * FROM events ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 15
recent_camera_events.description: Fetch the most recent events and updates across all cameras.

all_cameras_status.sql_template: SELECT * FROM cameras ORDER BY name ASC
all_cameras_status.description: Fetch the status of all registered cameras.

all_equipment_types.sql_template: SELECT * FROM equipment_types ORDER BY name ASC

recent_equipment_tracking.sql_template: SELECT * FROM equipment_tracking ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 15
recent_equipment_tracking.description: Fetch the latest tracking movements for all equipment.

all_patients.sql_template: SELECT * FROM patients ORDER BY name ASC
all_patients.description: Fetch a list of all patients.

all_medical_reports.sql_template: SELECT * FROM medical_reports ORDER BY date DESC
all_medical_reports.description: Fetch a list of all medical reports.

all_consultations.sql_template: SELECT * FROM consultations ORDER BY date DESC
all_consultations.description: Fetch a list of all consultations.

all_attendance.sql_template: SELECT * FROM attendance ORDER BY date DESC
all_attendance.description: Fetch a list of all attendance records.

all_equipment_items.sql_template: SELECT * FROM equipment_items ORDER BY equipment_id ASC
all_equipment_items.description: Fetch a list of all equipment items.

all_security_alerts.sql_template: SELECT * FROM security_alerts ORDER BY timestamp DESC
all_security_alerts.description: Fetch a list of all security alerts.
